title: MSPM0G3507 RED D5-D7 passive digital-input validation

target.board_revision: current user car; revision not marked

connections.power_source: 3.3 V module rail with common ground
instruments: operator multimeter for D-pin voltage cross-check

fixtures: 8-channel infrared module at one fixed height above white/black paper
loads: D5, D6, or D7 connected one at a time to PB17, PB18, or PB19
motors electrically disabled with TB6612 STBY low
boundary.safe_state: Motor power disabled, TB6612 STBY low, IR disconnected, module at 3.3 V, and no more than one D output connected to the MCU.

hazards.hazard: Module or MCU input exceeds 3.3 V
hazards.mitigation: Stop immediately and remove module power; verify the D pin with a multimeter before reconnecting.
Disconnect or independently disable motor power before programming and keep STBY low in firmware.

hazards.hazard: Pin conflict or multiple module outputs connected
hazards.mitigation: Connect only the named D pin for the active test and keep D1-D4, D8, and IR disconnected.

resource_owners.COM7: Codex passive capture after operator closes VOFA+

allowed_operations: enumerate present XDS110 and serial devices
open COM7 with RTS and DTR disabled

approval.policy: Only passive discovery and serial reads are in this plan. Firmware programming, reset, halt, run control, breakpoints, and live register access remain disabled.

rollback.trigger: Any stop condition, unexpected output, invalid voltage, OLED freeze, reset, heat, or communication loss.
steps: Disconnect the active D pin from the MCU.
Disable the car and motor power.
Close COM7 and all CCS, DSLite, and VOFA+ sessions.
rollback.verified_safe_state: Module is unpowered, D and IR pins are disconnected, motors are disabled, and no process owns COM7 or XDS110.

stop_conditions: Any input or module rail exceeds 3.3 V.
OLED heartbeat stops or the timestamp restarts unexpectedly.
Diagnostic faults or errors become nonzero.
The board or module heats, current exceeds 0.1 A, or a rail sags.
Any motor output or motion occurs.
More than one module D pin is connected.
COM7 data is malformed, missing, or owned by another process.

capture: raw serial logs for every channel and paper state

tests.requirement: The expected XDS110 and COM7 exist without opening a target session.
setup: Do not connect a debugger or serial terminal.
Keep motors and module signal pins disconnected.

action.operation: enumerate present XDS110 and serial devices

tests.expected: One present XDS110 composite device and COM7 Bluetooth SPP are reported with status OK.
tests.tolerance: Exact VID/PID and port identity; no target state change.
evidence: pnp inventory captured in task transcript
stop_conditions: Expected XDS110 or COM7 is absent.
Any inventory command requests target access.

tests.requirement: The manually programmed diagnostic image runs continuously with motors disabled and valid GPIO configuration.
setup: Operator manually programs the exact artifact hash outside this plan.
Close CCS debug, DSLite, VOFA+, and every other COM7 client.
Keep IR and all D pins disconnected; keep motor power disabled.
tests.expected: RED_DIGITAL_DIAG_V1 banner, 50 ms monotonic timestamps, advancing OLED heartbeat, and errors=0 faults=0.
tests.measurement: Raw COM7 log plus operator observation of OLED and STBY-safe motor state.
tests.tolerance: At least 100 complete frames; no timestamp restart, malformed frame, diagnostic error, fault, or motor output.
stop_conditions: Any errors or faults field is nonzero.
OLED heartbeat stops or timestamp restarts.

tests.requirement: D5, D6, and D7 each produce stable, reproducible digital levels over white and black paper.
setup: Use one fixed module height and one fixed white/black paper pair.
Connect only D5 to PB17, D6 to PB18, or D7 to PB19 for the active channel.
Keep IR and every inactive D pin disconnected.
Measure the active D-pin voltage with a multimeter in both states.
tests.expected: For each channel, at least 20 valid frames per paper state; the named GPIO value agrees with the corresponding DIN bit and the multimeter logic level.
tests.measurement: Six immutable raw captures plus multimeter readings and operator height/state labels.
tests.tolerance: At least 20 samples per state, zero GPIO/DIN disagreement, zero diagnostic errors/faults, and a stable black/white logic transition when the channel is functional.
rollback: Remove module power before changing the connected D pin.
Disconnect the active D pin and keep IR disconnected.
stop_conditions: Any errors or faults field is nonzero.
OLED heartbeat stops, timestamp restarts, or a frame is malformed.
The module or MCU heats or the rail sags.
More than one D pin is connected.
